name: Markdown Report
description: Writes a deterministic report and passes input port 0 through unchanged. The node has eight input ports; each section selects the table it reads with sections[].input (0..7, default 0). Sections are rendered in config order: table (input rows), profile (per-column statistics), text (a literal paragraph), metrics (row/column counters and per-column aggregates), image (a raster file) and page_break. Pipes, newlines and HTML metacharacters in cells are escaped; NULL renders as an empty cell.

file.title: Output file
file.description: Absolute path of the report file to write; parent directories are created.

title.title: Title
title.description: Optional document title rendered as a level-1 heading.

sections.title: Sections
sections.description: Report sections in output order; at least one is required.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: table - input rows; profile - per-column statistics; text - a literal paragraph; metrics - row/column counters and per-column aggregates; image - a raster file; page_break - an explicit page break.

title.title: Section title
title.description: Optional level-2 heading before the section.

input.title: Input port
input.description: Input port this section reads (table, profile, metrics); the port must be connected.

columns.title: Columns
columns.description: Columns to show (table, profile) or to summarise (metrics); empty means all columns for table/profile and no per-column metrics.

limit.title: Row limit
limit.description: Maximum rows rendered for a table section (default 100) or statistic rows for a profile section (default 1000).

text.title: Text
text.description: Literal paragraph; required for the text kind.

path.title: Image path
path.description: Path of a PNG, JPEG or GIF image; required for the image kind.

alt.title: Image alt text
alt.description: Alternative text used by Markdown and HTML.

width.title: Image width
width.description: Image width in pixels; empty means natural size (PDF/PPTX scale it to the page).
